en.text: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.

zhSimplified.text: 五旬节到了，门徒都聚集在一处。

zhTraditional.text: 五旬節到了，門徒都聚集在一處。

en.text: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

zhSimplified.text: 忽然，从天上有响声下来，好像一阵大风吹过，充满了他们所坐的屋子，

zhTraditional.text: 忽然，從天上有響聲下來，好像一陣大風吹過，充滿了他們所坐的屋子，

en.text: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.

zhSimplified.text: 又有舌头如火焰显现出来，分开落在他们各人头上。

zhTraditional.text: 又有舌頭如火焰顯現出來，分開落在他們各人頭上。

en.text: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.

zhSimplified.text: 他们就都被圣灵充满，按着圣灵所赐的口才说起别国的话来。

zhTraditional.text: 他們就都被聖靈充滿，按着聖靈所賜的口才說起別國的話來。

en.text: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，有虔诚的犹太人从天下各国来，住在耶路撒冷。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，有虔誠的猶太人從天下各國來，住在耶路撒冷。

en.text: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.

zhSimplified.text: 这声音一响，众人都来聚集，各人听见门徒用众人的乡谈说话，就甚纳闷；

zhTraditional.text: 這聲音一響，眾人都來聚集，各人聽見門徒用眾人的鄉談說話，就甚納悶；

en.text: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?

zhSimplified.text: 都惊讶希奇说：「看哪，这说话的不都是加利利人吗？

zhTraditional.text: 都驚訝希奇說：「看哪，這說話的不都是加利利人嗎？

en.text: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?

zhSimplified.text: 我们各人怎么听见他们说我们生来所用的乡谈呢？

zhTraditional.text: 我們各人怎麼聽見他們說我們生來所用的鄉談呢？

en.text: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,

zhSimplified.text: 我们帕提亚人、米底亚人、以拦人，和住在美索不达米亚、犹太、加帕多家、本都、亚细亚、

zhTraditional.text: 我們帕提亞人、米底亞人、以攔人，和住在美索不達米亞、猶太、加帕多家、本都、亞細亞、

en.text: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,

zhSimplified.text: 弗吕家、旁非利亚、埃及的人，并靠近古利奈的利比亚一带地方的人，从罗马来的客旅中，或是犹太人，或是进犹太教的人，

zhTraditional.text: 弗呂家、旁非利亞、埃及的人，並靠近古利奈的利比亞一帶地方的人，從羅馬來的客旅中，或是猶太人，或是進猶太教的人，

en.text: Cretans and Arabians—we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”

zhSimplified.text: 克里特和阿拉伯人，都听见他们用我们的乡谈，讲说 神的大作为。」

zhTraditional.text: 克里特和阿拉伯人，都聽見他們用我們的鄉談，講說上帝的大作為。」

en.text: They were all amazed and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”

zhSimplified.text: 众人就都惊讶猜疑，彼此说：「这是什么意思呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 眾人就都驚訝猜疑，彼此說：「這是甚麼意思呢？」

en.text: Others, mocking, said, “They are filled with new wine.”

zhSimplified.text: 还有人讥诮说：「他们无非是新酒灌满了。」

zhTraditional.text: 還有人譏誚說：「他們無非是新酒灌滿了。」

en.text: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice and spoke out to them, “You men of Judea and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.

zhSimplified.text: 彼得和十一个使徒站起，高声说：「犹太人和一切住在耶路撒冷的人哪，这件事你们当知道，也当侧耳听我的话。

zhTraditional.text: 彼得和十一個使徒站起，高聲說：「猶太人和一切住在耶路撒冷的人哪，這件事你們當知道，也當側耳聽我的話。

en.text: For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.

zhSimplified.text: 你们想这些人是醉了；其实不是醉了，因为时候刚到巳初。

zhTraditional.text: 你們想這些人是醉了；其實不是醉了，因為時候剛到巳初。

en.text: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:

zhSimplified.text: 这正是先知约珥所说的：

zhTraditional.text: 這正是先知約珥所說的：

en.text: ‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will dream dreams.

zhSimplified.text: 神说：在末后的日子， 我要将我的灵浇灌凡有血气的。 你们的儿女要说预言； 你们的少年人要见异象； 老年人要做异梦。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝說：在末後的日子， 我要將我的靈澆灌凡有血氣的。 你們的兒女要說預言； 你們的少年人要見異象； 老年人要做異夢。

en.text: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.

zhSimplified.text: 在那些日子， 我要将我的灵浇灌我的仆人和使女， 他们就要说预言。

zhTraditional.text: 在那些日子， 我要將我的靈澆灌我的僕人和使女， 他們就要說預言。

en.text: I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath: blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.

zhSimplified.text: 在天上，我要显出奇事； 在地下，我要显出神迹； 有血，有火，有烟雾。

zhTraditional.text: 在天上，我要顯出奇事； 在地下， 我要顯出神蹟； 有血，有火，有煙霧。

en.text: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.

zhSimplified.text: 日头要变为黑暗， 月亮要变为血； 这都在主大而明显的日子未到以前。

zhTraditional.text: 日頭要變為黑暗， 月亮要變為血； 這都在主大而明顯的日子未到以前。

en.text: It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’

zhSimplified.text: 到那时候， 凡求告主名的，就必得救。

zhTraditional.text: 到那時候， 凡求告主名的，就必得救。

en.text: “Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you, even as you yourselves know,

zhSimplified.text: 「以色列人哪，请听我的话： 神借着拿撒勒人耶稣在你们中间施行异能、奇事、神迹，将他证明出来，这是你们自己知道的。

zhTraditional.text: 「以色列人哪，請聽我的話：上帝藉着拿撒勒人耶穌在你們中間施行異能、奇事、神蹟，將他證明出來，這是你們自己知道的。

en.text: him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men, crucified and killed;

zhSimplified.text: 他既按着 神的定旨先见被交与人，你们就借着无法之人的手，把他钉在十字架上，杀了。

zhTraditional.text: 他既按着上帝的定旨先見被交與人，你們就藉着無法之人的手，把他釘在十字架上，殺了。

en.text: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.

zhSimplified.text: 神却将死的痛苦解释了，叫他复活，因为他原不能被死拘禁。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝卻將死的痛苦解釋了，叫他復活，因為他原不能被死拘禁。

en.text: For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫指着他说： 我看见主常在我眼前； 他在我右边，叫我不至于摇动。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛指着他說： 我看見主常在我眼前； 他在我右邊，叫我不至於搖動。

en.text: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover my flesh also will dwell in hope,

zhSimplified.text: 所以，我心里欢喜， 我的灵快乐； 并且我的肉身要安居在指望中。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，我心裏歡喜， 我的靈快樂； 並且我的肉身要安居在指望中。

en.text: because you will not leave my soul in Hades, neither will you allow your Holy One to see decay.

zhSimplified.text: 因你必不将我的灵魂撇在阴间， 也不叫你的圣者见朽坏。

zhTraditional.text: 因你必不將我的靈魂撇在陰間， 也不叫你的聖者見朽壞。

en.text: You made known to me the ways of life. You will make me full of gladness with your presence.’

zhSimplified.text: 你已将生命的道路指示我， 必叫我因见你的面 得着满足的快乐。

zhTraditional.text: 你已將生命的道路指示我， 必叫我因見你的面 得着滿足的快樂。

en.text: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.

zhSimplified.text: 「弟兄们！先祖大卫的事，我可以明明地对你们说：他死了，也葬埋了，并且他的坟墓直到今日还在我们这里。

zhTraditional.text: 「弟兄們！先祖大衛的事，我可以明明地對你們說：他死了，也葬埋了，並且他的墳墓直到今日還在我們這裏。

en.text: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,

zhSimplified.text: 大卫既是先知，又晓得 神曾向他起誓，要从他的后裔中立一位坐在他的宝座上，

zhTraditional.text: 大衛既是先知，又曉得上帝曾向他起誓，要從他的後裔中立一位坐在他的寶座上，

en.text: he foreseeing this, spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that his soul wasn’t left in Hades, and his flesh didn’t see decay.

zhSimplified.text: 就预先看明这事，讲论基督复活说： 他的灵魂不撇在阴间； 他的肉身也不见朽坏。

zhTraditional.text: 就預先看明這事，講論基督復活說： 他的靈魂不撇在陰間； 他的肉身也不見朽壞。

en.text: This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.

zhSimplified.text: 这耶稣， 神已经叫他复活了，我们都为这事作见证。

zhTraditional.text: 這耶穌，上帝已經叫他復活了，我們都為這事作見證。

en.text: Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this which you now see and hear.

zhSimplified.text: 他既被 神的右手高举，又从父受了所应许的圣灵，就把你们所看见所听见的，浇灌下来。

footnotes.text: - 2:33 或译：他既高举在 神的右边

zhTraditional.text: 他既被上帝的右手高舉，又從父受了所應許的聖靈，就把你們所看見所聽見的，澆灌下來。

footnotes.text: - 2:33 或譯：他既高舉在上帝的右邊

en.text: For David didn’t ascend into the heavens, but he says himself, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit by my right hand

zhSimplified.text: 大卫并没有升到天上，但自己说： 主对我主说： 你坐在我的右边，

zhTraditional.text: 大衛並沒有升到天上，但自己說： 主對我主說： 你坐在我的右邊，

en.text: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”’

zhSimplified.text: 等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳。

zhTraditional.text: 等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳。

en.text: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”

zhSimplified.text: 「故此，以色列全家当确实地知道，你们钉在十字架上的这位耶稣， 神已经立他为主，为基督了。」

zhTraditional.text: 「故此，以色列全家當確實地知道，你們釘在十字架上的這位耶穌，上帝已經立他為主，為基督了。」

en.text: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”

zhSimplified.text: 众人听见这话，觉得扎心，就对彼得和其余的使徒说：「弟兄们，我们当怎样行？」

zhTraditional.text: 眾人聽見這話，覺得扎心，就對彼得和其餘的使徒說：「弟兄們，我們當怎樣行？」

en.text: Peter said to them, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

zhSimplified.text: 彼得说：「你们各人要悔改，奉耶稣基督的名受洗，叫你们的罪得赦，就必领受所赐的圣灵；

zhTraditional.text: 彼得說：「你們各人要悔改，奉耶穌基督的名受洗，叫你們的罪得赦，就必領受所賜的聖靈；

en.text: For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.”

zhSimplified.text: 因为这应许是给你们和你们的儿女，并一切在远方的人，就是主—我们 神所召来的。」

zhTraditional.text: 因為這應許是給你們和你們的兒女，並一切在遠方的人，就是主－我們上帝所召來的。」

en.text: With many other words he testified and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”

zhSimplified.text: 彼得还用许多话作见证，劝勉他们说：「你们当救自己脱离这弯曲的世代。」

zhTraditional.text: 彼得還用許多話作見證，勸勉他們說：「你們當救自己脫離這彎曲的世代。」

en.text: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.

zhSimplified.text: 于是领受他话的人就受了洗。那一天，门徒约添了三千人，

zhTraditional.text: 於是領受他話的人就受了洗。那一天，門徒約添了三千人，

en.text: They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.

zhSimplified.text: 都恒心遵守使徒的教训，彼此交接，擘饼，祈祷。

zhTraditional.text: 都恆心遵守使徒的教訓，彼此交接，擘餅，祈禱。

en.text: Fear came on every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.

zhSimplified.text: 众人都惧怕；使徒又行了许多奇事神迹。

zhTraditional.text: 眾人都懼怕；使徒又行了許多奇事神蹟。

en.text: All who believed were together, and had all things in common.

zhSimplified.text: 信的人都在一处，凡物公用，

zhTraditional.text: 信的人都在一處，凡物公用，

en.text: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.

zhSimplified.text: 并且卖了田产、家业，照各人所需用的分给各人。

zhTraditional.text: 並且賣了田產、家業，照各人所需用的分給各人。

en.text: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,

zhSimplified.text: 他们天天同心合意恒切地在殿里，且在家中擘饼，存着欢喜、诚实的心用饭，

zhTraditional.text: 他們天天同心合意恆切地在殿裏，且在家中擘餅，存着歡喜、誠實的心用飯，

en.text: praising God and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.

zhSimplified.text: 赞美 神，得众民的喜爱。主将得救的人天天加给他们。

zhTraditional.text: 讚美上帝，得眾民的喜愛。主將得救的人天天加給他們。
